name: Sexual Sin
overview: Scripture clearly condemns sexual sin as a serious offense against God's design for holiness and purity. Sexual immorality, including adultery, fornication, and lust, is portrayed as destructive to the soul and dishonoring to the marriage covenant, which God declares honorable and undefiled. Believers are called to avoid even the appearance of such sins, recognizing that God will judge those who persist in sexual unfaithfulness and uncleanness. True understanding and sanctified living involve fleeing from these sins as incompatible with the life of holiness to which Christians are called.
